doctor.title: osTicket connection
doctor.desc: Checks that verify, before allowing writes, that TailTicket is correctly and safely connected to the osTicket database.
doctor.blocked: Writes blocked: {count, plural, one {# problem to fix} other {# problems to fix}}.

legend.block: writes are not safe until the problem is fixed
legend.warn: worth knowing, does not prevent writes (also when the check cannot be verified)

doctor.contentNote: Check results are reported in Italian. Passwords, salts, keys and tokens are never shown.
